newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ConsRutile reviews rutile mine reopen.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ConsRutile reviews rutile mine reopen.

text.p: Mineral sands miner Consolidated Rutile Ltd said on Thursday that a restart plan for the Sierra Rutile mine is under review in conjunction with a consortium of international development banks.
The rutile mine in the west African country of Sierra Leone was overrun by rebels in January 1995.

Consolidated Rutile said a number of challenges remain for the mine reopening, including securing markets for the output from Sierra Rutile, improving the fiscal regime in Sierra Leone under which the mine operates, and funding.
"Activities to address these challenges are being undertaken by the management of Sierra Rutile Ltd and its two shareholders, Consolidated Rutile Ltd and Nord Resources (Corp).
Both companies each own a 50 percent stake in the mine.
Consolidated Rutile is 50.1 percent owned by Cudgen RZ Ltd, which in turn is about 77 percent owned by RGC Ltd.
Consolidated Rutile shares closed a cent higher at 87 cents.
